listing.summary: 10 New Kit-bashed Ships for Starsector for Pirates, Independents, and the Luddic Church. As with all of my nonsense, focused on the early and mid-game. (Some of these kit bashes are mine, others are from the Spiral Arms II thread, all credit to their proper owners)

description:
Legacy of Leonis

Leonis' crossing of the Abyss would have been considered heroic, had it not been performed for the purpose of spreading terror and dismay.

Version 1.0 stable.
10 New Kit-bashed Ships for Starsector for Pirates, Independents, and the Luddic Church. As with all of my nonsense, focused on the early and mid-game. (Some of these kit bashes are mine, others are from the Spiral Arms II thread, all credit to their proper owners)

Download here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aCl6sCinXleV8IG2jlKe4xjRkW4jtm8g?usp=sharing

Besides filling out the lore, the idea here is to add a couple of raiding ships which will play differently, as well as improve the combat effectiveness of combat tankers by creating "narrow broadside" ships with (terrible-to-quite-good) shields, which can survive getting chased by pirates long enough to safely retreat from battle, as well as presenting a hedgehog when this isn't possible. All of the ships are set up to "cut angles" in a way which theoretically minimizes the amount of shield and hull target they present to foes (unless you're surrounded, in which case good luck, but if you're surrounded in a combat freighter, you're probably toast already).

Also includes two combat tankers, one for Independent/civilian use, and one set up to be a long-distance scout-raiding frigate. They should be pretty well-balanced and help out those who enjoy scrappy-underdog play. Full in-game descriptions for meta-lore.

Pirates

Spoiler

Argo. Like a Mule, but it didn't skip leg day. Sucks down fuel like a pirate bar slams hooch.

Zarf and Trojan. Broadside logistics ships. One of these is actually a troop transport.

Spinneret. A fast combat-tanker for raiding and not leaving antimatter fuel behind.

Plumbata. A penal strike craft pretending to be a Kite. Definitely not inspired by Cylons or anything.

Independent Civilian-Hulled Ships

Spoiler

Hastates. A nimble little pain in the backside for convoy raiders.

Handshake, Nopali, Scutum. They may not win a giant brawl, but they'll live to get out of one.

Pugnus looks like an Argo, doesn't handle like one. Referred to lovingly as Pugnus Innocenti by those Luddics fortunate enough to be escorted by one.

Also, I finally figured out how to host images. Yay!

aiDescription: Adds ten new ships designed for early and mid-game play, including raiding vessels and improved combat tankers. These ships feature narrow broadsides and shields to help survive pirate attacks and retreat safely. The pack includes ships for pirates, independent civilians, and the Luddic Church, with specific designs for scouting, raiding, and convoy defense.
